newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firmer, fuel oil softer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firmer, fuel oil softer.

text.p: NWE oil products mainly stronger on Wednesday, traders said.
Gasoline was firmer with futures but activity was slack. Eurograde barges traded at $203 fob ARA.
Naphtha was firmer with crude. Buying was slack but offers were thin too.
Gas oil was stronger with futures. Premiums were firm with Russian material in demand and strong interest in low sulphur.
Fuel oil barges were softer as thin demand impacted. Cargoes were more resilient taking support from perceived tightness.
